source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 10.14 with Figures 10.5 and 10.6, printed pages 227-228.

blocks.text: Teen aham qism ke half-cells ki E standard qeematein standard hydrogen electrode se jor kar milti hain: metal/metal ion (Cu2+/Cu), non-metal/non-metal ion (Cl2/Cl-) aur ion/ion (Fe3+/Fe2+). Figure 10.5 Cu2+/Cu half-cell ki paimaish dikhati hai: SHE se jora jaye to voltage +0.34 V hai, copper musbat terminal (musbat pole) aur SHE manfi terminal. Half-equations Cu2+(aq) + 2e- se Cu(s), E standard = +0.34 V, aur H+(aq) + e- se 1/2 H2(g), E standard = 0.00 V hain. Qeematein dikhati hain ke Cu2+ ions H+ ions se aasani se reduce hote hain (zyada musbat E standard) aur electrons lene ka zyada imkan rakhte hain, to Cu2+ H+/H2 half-cell se electrons leta hai aur H2 Cu2+/Cu half-cell ko electrons deta hai.

Figure 10.6 Zn2+/Zn half-cell dikhati hai: us ka voltage -0.76 V hai, zinc manfi terminal aur hydrogen electrode musbat terminal. Half-equations H+ + e- se 1/2 H2, 0.00 V, aur Zn2+ + 2e- se Zn, -0.76 V hain. Zn2+ ions H+ ions se mushkil se reduce hote hain (zyada manfi E standard) aur electrons lene ka kam imkan rakhte hain, to Zn H+/H2 half-cell ko electrons deta hai aur H+ ions Zn2+/Zn half-cell se electrons lete hain. In do misalon se, reduction cell ke musbat terminal par hoti hai (Zn2+/Zn; H+/H2 cell mein: 2H+ + 2e- se H2) aur oxidation manfi terminal par (Zn se Zn2+ + 2e-).

blocks.prompt: E standard Cl2/2Cl- +1.36 V, Br2/2Br- +1.07 V aur I2/2I- +0.54 V ke saath wazahat karein ke bromine iodide ions ko oxidise karti hai magar chloride ions se react nahi karti (Quick Check 10.6a).
blocks.explanation: E standard jitna zyada musbat, baen taraf ki species utni aasani se reduce hoti hai. Br2 (+1.07 V) I2 (+0.54 V) se aasani se reduce hoti hai, to Br2 I- se electrons le kar use iodine mein oxidise karti hai. Cl2 (+1.36 V) Br2 se aasani se reduce hoti hai, to Cl- Br2 ko electrons nahi de sakta; ulta, chlorine ka bromide ko oxidise karna, hota hai.

items: Half-cell qismein: metal/ion (Cu2+/Cu), non-metal/ion (Cl2/Cl-), ion/ion (Fe3+/Fe2+). SHE ke muqable: Cu2+/Cu +0.34 V (copper musbat pole, Cu2+ H+ se aasani se reduce); Zn2+/Zn -0.76 V (zinc manfi pole, Zn2+ mushkil se reduce).
Reduction musbat terminal par, oxidation manfi terminal par.
